title: VBA observes black Diwali in Jalna over drought handling
seoTitle: Jalna VBA black Diwali drought protest

tea.why: Protesters say the government failed to address severe drought conditions caused by irregular rainfall and poor planning.
tea.want: They demand an official drought declaration, a complete loan waiver, higher financial relief, and regular drinking water supply.
tea.changed: Nov 8: VBA members gathered outside the district collector's office in Jalna to protest by eating bajra bhakri and chutney.

summary: On November 8, 2026, members of the Vanchit Bahujan Aghadi (VBA) led by Prakash Ambedkar observed a black Diwali outside the district collector's office in Jalna, Maharashtra. Protesters consumed traditional bajra bhakri and chutney to demonstrate against the government's handling of severe drought conditions caused by irregular rainfall and poor planning. Organisers stated that withered crops and shortages of drinking water and cattle fodder have distressed farmers, agricultural labourers, and rural workers. The district party chief criticised the administration's financial aid of Rs 5,000 per farmer as inadequate and questioned what support was available for landless workers. Additionally, protesters targeted the BJP-controlled Jalna City Municipal Corporation for failing to supply regular drinking water. No official response from the government was reported in the sources.
demands: Provide immediate relief to affected farmers
Ensure regular drinking water supply for city residents
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: VBA members gathered outside the Jalna district collector's office and consumed bajra bhakri and chutney for a black Diwali protest.
